## Research interests

Plant immunity and molecular plant–microbe interactions, with a focus on
quantitative resistance to broad host-range necrotrophic fungi. Transcriptional
regulators of defence, CRISPR-based genome editing, and omics approaches in
lettuce (*Lactuca sativa*) and its wild relatives.

## Skills

**Plant pathology** — detached-leaf and whole-plant infection assays with
*B. cinerea* and *S. sclerotiorum*; fungal culture and inoculum preparation;
lesion phenotyping.

**Molecular biology** — CRISPR/Cas construct design and genome editing; cloning;
plant transformation; *Arabidopsis* and lettuce transgenics; qRT-PCR.

**Omics & analysis** — transcriptome analysis, differential expression, and
data handling in R.
